content: {"reasoning":"The claim is denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization that was required at service time. The retro-auth window (14 days) is closed, the payer offers no peer-to-peer, and an appeal with medical necessity has already been attempted without success. Since the missing auth is a provider administrative failure, the balance cannot be billed to the patient, and no remaining action can legitimately recover payment, so the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
